notes.title: FICTION #F3F release!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey all![/b] Announcing the FICTION #F3F collection of ambient games including Nightline, Carcavas, That Feeling Blue, æ, and Sands of Voltark. These five pieces, originally released between 2018 - 21, have been remastered, enhanced and now available on Steam :)

[previewyoutube=6cblPspMOSE;full][/previewyoutube]

The collection features hours of music, dynamic 3D first person exploration and (mostly) peaceful open worlds. From infinite train rides to sun bleached deserts, there’s quite a lot to experience at leisure:)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480540/FICTION_F3F/

notes.title: Big VR Update for Oculus Headsets
notes.notes:
[h1]This new update introduces 8 worlds to explore and was premiered in the Indie Megabooth's PAX East 2019 showcase![/h1]

At the moment it is only compatible with Oculus Headsets, the original SteamVR alpha is still available as a beta branch and can be re-enabled from the Properties Menu.

There's the retro Neon City, a beautiful Tron like CAD construct full of abstracted skyscrapers and doodle like forests. The bright Deconstructivist City, with towering shapes and labyrinthine alleys.  The Desert Canyon, a wonderful oasis whose ancient ruins defy gravity. The Tropic Island, rendered in a cacophony of primary colors. And 4 Edge worlds that truly bend the senses.

[h1]Controls:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/1d9f5d78da58cfe6750cefb76090409045e3b82c.png[/img]

Use the left joystick to move around the worlds, left index trigger to sprint and right index finger to jump. The right joystick will hard rotate your view by 45 degrees. You can move forward in whichever direction that you are looking at in the physical world.

[h1]Keyboard Dev Menu:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/141f12fe07cc97cac8c3518ea0965b533f9d0831.png[/img]

The Developer access keys let you force load multiple different worlds as well as Quit the game. When loading a world it will randomly choose from a variety of possible starting locations.


[h1]Important:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Only compatible with Oculus Headsets at the moment.
[*] Intended for a seated or standing experience.
[*] For use with Oculus Touch Controllers.
[*] This is still an alpha, as such there are a few bugs and discrepancies with the PC version.
[*] If you run into any problems, bugs or want to actively participate in the development process please feel free to post in the VR discussion board!
[*] To play the original experimental SteamVR compatible alpha, you can re-enable it from the game's Properties Beta Options, and is listed as "vive - SteamVR". The launcher option will not work so you have to manually access this VR edition: open the 0N0WVR.exe in the VR folder found inside your game's installation directory.
[/list]

notes.title: 0°N 0°W Update 1.4
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30292847/a6a98ef966419a1a9742479337e2f51b3e335646.gif[/img]

[h1]Update 1.4, Changes and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added Features/Flora/Fauna to almost 60% of the game (more to come!).
[*]Added 3 new dimensions, can you find them?
[*]Fixed Alt-Tab issue on multi-screen situations.
[*]Fixed memory leaks on three dimensions.
[*]Fixed bug where Intro movie in ultra widescreen was showing the skybox.
[*]Fixed rare bug where gravity of a dimension would transfer to other dimensions.
[*]Fixed inability to run/sprint in one dimension.
[*]Fixed rare bug where player would fall into infinity on one dimension.
[*]Added a timeout before a particular colorful cityscape dimension starts shifting everywhere to prevent player from getting stuck.
[*]Increased distance view / field of vision on some dimensions.
[*]Added even more exit doors to tunnel maze in (!7`/ |2(_)!|\\|3|).
[*]Optimized AI on multiple dimensions to increase performance.
[*]Countless other small fixes and performance improvements everywhere!
[*]Standalone VR alpha dlc is no longer bundled with the game and is now optional!
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming: [/h1]

[list]
[*]Adding more Features/Flora/Fauna to all dimensions.
[*]More dimensions :)
[*]The level selection menu is getting a visual/functional rehaul.
[*]Hopefully full controller support and mouse invert/sensitivity control, this is proving more tricky than I thought.
[/list]

notes.title: 0°N 0°W Update 1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.3, Changes and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed game crash bug introduced in 1.2, all door transtitions now work as intended.
[*]Fixed key layout graphic to reflect f12 for photo capture.
[*]Fixed movement range of randomized skyscrapers in (!7`/ 10 "(|_0(_)|)" to prevent the player from getting trapped in apartment.
[*]Fixed Various collision hitches throughout the game.
[*]Added environmental details/facets in three worlds (no spoilers)
[*]Added sounds to two worlds (no spoilers)
[*]Added more exit doors to tunnel maze in (!7`/ |2(_)!|\\|3|), as the sole couple exits were too hard to find.
[*]Added ability to press any key or click to skip intro splash screens.
[/list]

[h1]Reached a decision on when VR will be released and how it will be implemented, will post an announcement tomorrow on this :) [/h1]

notes.title: 0°N 0°W Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.2, Changes and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated the Movement System: The [b]walking inertia/lag/delay after key-press is fixed![/b] Now you can approach things slowly or platform precisely without fear of sliding onwards (It's even more noticeable on controllers).
[*]Level Selection Menu is now accessible from the Main Menu. To do so click on the box full of tapes under the center table (the one with the 'Story Book').
[*]Added 2 ferns to the Main Menu and other miscellaneous embellishments. More importantly the Exit Game Door is now marked with an exit sign.
[*]Fixed cursor missing on Main Menu after rare instances of reloading .
[*]Removed cursor from intro splash screens.
[*]Changed Photo capture default key from 'P' to 'F12' to match the Steam Overlay screenshot function. This can always be changed to your preference on the startup dialog screen. Local copies of your photos are saved in your game's install directory as .png files '0°N 0°W/0N0W_Data/Photos/'. Currently missing update to splash screen diagram to illustrate this recent change, will update this in next patch.
[*]Fixed even more misbehaving doors.
[/list]

[h1] Also........ Big Announcement about VR capabilities this coming week! Stay tuned ;) [/h1]

notes.title: 0°N 0°W Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.1, Changes and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Cursor is now locked to window boundaries.
[*]Adjusted Treble and Middle frequencies of Musicscape in (!7`/ 1 "|\\|30|\\|"
[*]Changed Soundscape and Musicscape in  |D!><3|_ 
[*]Fixed bug in startup resolution window where Vsync and 8x MSAA would get enabled on 'Full Textures' Option.
[*]Fixed rare bug enabling Player to climb atop car on small town and get stuck.
[*]Fixed problem with the theater's 'surprise' where transition audio would activate prior to sequence.
[*]Fixed rare instance where Player could get stuck on polyhedrons on |)(_)5|< (4|\\|`/0|\\|.
[*]Fixed a troublesome door on (!7`/ 3 "|3|2!9|-|7".
[*]Fixed rare bug preventing 'SPOILER' from activating upon discovering daytime small town.
[*]Fixed Steam not starting up when attempting to start game with Steam closed.

[/list]

[h1]Update Roadmap: [/h1]
(In no particular order)
[list]
[*]Expanded Mouse Controls (Inversion + Sensitivity).
[*]Full Controller Support and integration with Steam's Big Screen.
[*]Photo Mode.
[*]Linux and OSx support.
[/list]

[h1]Also in the works:[/h1]
[list]
[*]-VR Edition.
[*]-Nintendo Switch and Consoles support (For this 0°N 0°W will need your support! The more the word spreads about this experience the more likely that they'll either approach or accept the submission).
[/list]
